title: MindForge Project Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for MINDFORGE.md bracketed parameter assignments ([KEY] = value)

VERSION.description: MindForge version this registry targets (must equal package.json version)

REQUIRED_CORE_VERSION.description: Minimum MindForge core version required by this project

SOVEREIGN_IDENTITY.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: identity verification is always required

AUTO_SWARM_THRESHOLD.description: Difficulty score above which a swarm is auto-spawned

DYNAMISM_LEVEL.description: How aggressively the engine reshapes its own plan (1=static, 5=fully dynamic)

ADS_LOOP_ENFORCED.description: Enforce the adversarial decision loop before architectural change

RAG_2_AUTO_SHADOW.description: Run RAG-2 retrieval in shadow mode

ENABLE_ZTAI.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: zero-trust agent identity cannot be bypassed

PQAS_ENFORCED.description: Post-quantum attestation enforcement (SIMULATED/inactive by default — see bin/governance/quantum-crypto.js)

PLANNER.description: Model id for the planning persona (canonical: PLANNER_MODEL)

EXECUTOR.description: Model id for execution agents (canonical: EXECUTOR_MODEL)

REVIEWER.description: Model id for the code reviewer (canonical: REVIEWER_MODEL)

VERIFIER.description: Model id for the verification persona (canonical: VERIFIER_MODEL)

SECURITY.description: Model id for security review (canonical: SECURITY_MODEL)

DEBUG.description: Model id for the debug specialist (canonical: DEBUG_MODEL)

RESEARCH.description: Model id for the research agent (canonical: RESEARCH_MODEL)

QA.description: Model id for the QA engineer (canonical: QA_MODEL)

QUICK.description: Model id for tier-1 budget-bias tasks (canonical: QUICK_MODEL)

COST_WARN_USD.description: Daily spend at which a cost warning is emitted

COST_HARD_LIMIT_USD.description: Daily hard cost limit in USD. ENFORCED as of 11.9.3 (COST-02): bin/models/cost-tracker.js preflight() throws COST_LIMIT_REACHED once today's ledger spend plus the call estimate reaches this value, and bin/models/model-client.js re-throws it. 0 disables the cap, and so does omitting the key (it is `recommended`, not `required`) — an upgrade never rewrites an existing MINDFORGE.md. A present-but-unparseable value throws COST_LIMIT_MISCONFIGURED rather than silently running uncapped.

ADS_DEBATE_ROUNDS.description: Red-team/blue-team debate rounds per architectural decision

MIN_SOUL_SCORE.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: minimum SOUL score required for architectural changes

REQUIRE_ADR.description: Require an ADR for architectural decisions

BLOCK_ON_SECURITY.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: security gate enforcement cannot be disabled

API_URL.description: Base URL of the project API under development

FORBIDDEN.description: Multi-line block of project prohibitions injected into every agent prompt

INSTRUCTIONS.description: Multi-line block of project instructions injected into every agent prompt

MINDFORGE_VERSION_REQUIRED.description: Minimum MindForge version required for this config

PLANNER_MODEL.description: DEPRECATED long form of [PLANNER]. Model id for the planning agent (free-form: model ids churn faster than this schema)

EXECUTOR_MODEL.description: DEPRECATED long form of [EXECUTOR]. Model id for execution agents

REVIEWER_MODEL.description: DEPRECATED long form of [REVIEWER]. Model id for the code reviewer

SECURITY_MODEL.description: DEPRECATED long form of [SECURITY]. Model id for security review

TIER1_AUTO_APPROVE.description: Auto-approve Tier 1 changes without user confirmation

WAVE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.description: Require user confirmation before each execution wave

AUTO_DISCUSS_PHASE.description: Automatically run discuss-phase before every plan-phase

VERIFY_PASS_RATE_WARNING_THRESHOLD.description: Warn when first-attempt verify pass rate drops below this

COMPACTION_THRESHOLD_PCT.description: Context window percentage that triggers compaction

MAX_TASKS_PER_PHASE.description: Suggest phase split when task count exceeds this

MAX_FUNCTION_LINES.description: Maximum allowed function length in lines

MAX_CYCLOMATIC_COMPLEXITY.description: Maximum allowed cyclomatic complexity per function

BLOCK_ON_MEDIUM_SECURITY_FINDINGS.description: Block PR creation on MEDIUM security findings (default: only HIGH+)

ALWAYS_LOAD_SKILLS.description: Comma-separated list of skills to always load regardless of triggers

DISABLED_SKILLS.description: Comma-separated list of skills to never load

MAX_FULL_SKILL_INJECTIONS.description: Maximum number of skills to inject in full (rest are summarised)

BRANCHING_STRATEGY.description: Git branching strategy for MindForge phases

NOTIFY_ON.description: Comma-separated events that trigger Slack notifications

DISCUSS_PHASE_REQUIRED_ABOVE_DIFFICULTY.description: Require discuss-phase when difficulty score exceeds this value

AI_REVIEW_DAILY_LIMIT.description: Maximum AI PR reviews per day (0 = unlimited)

CI_AUTO_APPROVE_TIER2.description: Auto-approve Tier 2 changes in CI mode

CI_SECURITY_SCAN.description: Run security scan in CI mode

CI_MIN_COVERAGE_PCT.description: Minimum test coverage in CI (may differ from interactive threshold)

CI_OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: Output format for CI execution logs

SECURITY_AUTOTRIGGER.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: security auto-trigger for auth/payment/PII changes

PLAN_FIRST.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: plan-first rule (no implementation without a PLAN)

AUDIT_WRITING.description: NON-OVERRIDABLE: AUDIT.jsonl writing for every significant action
